meta.name: dev-ask
meta.description: Advisory router — query Claude, Codex, or Gemini for a quick second opinion. Experimental — only Claude is guaranteed available; other models require dev-mcp-setup configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 向多个AI模型咨询技术问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在开发中需要快速获取多个AI模型的建议
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple AI models for technical advice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick second opinions from multiple AI models during development

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让Claude单独向某个模型（Claude、Codex或Gemini）提问，并返回该模型的回答和来源。用于快速获取特定模型的第二意见。注意：仅Claude默认可用，其他需配置。
howto.when: 当你需要某个特定模型对问题给出意见，或想对比不同模型回答时触发。通常是你主动要求向某个模型提问。

say.text: 请用Gemini检查这段Python代码的潜在问题。
用Codex解释一下堆排序的原理。
向Claude询问这个设计的备选方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to query a specific model (Claude, Codex, or Gemini) and return that model's answer. Useful for getting a quick second opinion from a particular LLM. Note: Only Claude is available by default; others require configuration via dev-mcp-setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a quick second opinion from a specific model, or want to compare how different models approach the same problem. Typically you explicitly request a query to one model.

say_en.text: Ask Gemini to check potential issues in this Python code.
Use Codex to explain heap sort.
